units.text: INT. POPPY'S KITCHEN - NIGHT
The whole street is dark.
One candle on the counter, one torch in Poppy's mouth.
She is on her knees, head inside an open cupboard.
I know I have matches. I bought matches. I remember the matches.
units.name: POPPY
paren: muffled, torch in mouth

units.text: You also remember buying a fire extinguisher and that was a dream.
units.name: BEN
paren: he stands in the doorway holding a bag of frozen peas against his forehead

units.text: It was a very vivid dream.
units.name: POPPY
paren: she pulls out her head, spits the torch into her hand

units.text: Okay. Okay. I'm fine. Who puts a saucepan on the floor?
units.name: BEN
paren: he steps forward, trips on a saucepan, catches himself on the fridge

units.text: Someone who was making you dinner before the lights went out.
units.name: POPPY
paren: pointing the torch at him

units.text: That is soup?
units.name: BEN
paren: he looks at the pot, then at her, then at the pot

units.text: That is a risotto in its early years.
units.name: POPPY
paren: she stands, wipes her hands on her jeans

units.text: Poppy. I'm sorry. I love it. I love its early years.
units.name: BEN
paren: he laughs, then stops laughing when he sees she is not laughing

units.text: Say it again.
units.name: POPPY
paren: she steps closer, the torch under her chin, spooky

units.text: I love it.
units.name: BEN
paren: he steps back into the table

units.text: No. The other thing. From the car.
units.name: POPPY
paren: softer, torch lowered

units.text: I said I might be in love with you. Might. I said might.
units.name: BEN
paren: a long breath, peas slipping down his face

units.text: You said might very quickly.
units.name: POPPY
paren: she smiles, looks at the floor, then at him

units.text: I was driving.
units.name: BEN
paren: nodding, with great dignity

units.text: CLOSE ON the candle.
It flickers.
Ben, I think I am also a bit of a might.
units.name: POPPY
paren: whisper

units.text: Good. That's a good might. We can work with that.
units.name: BEN
paren: he lowers the peas, finally

units.text: The back door BANGS open.
Cold air, flashlights swinging across the ceiling.
THE TWINS, Poppy's nine-year-old nieces in matching raincoats, march in with a candle in each hand and a very large cake between them.
Surprise!
units.name: THE TWINS

units.text: Ow! It's not even my birthday!
units.name: POPPY
paren: she jumps and hits her head on the cupboard door

units.text: It is in the dark!
units.name: THE TWINS

units.text: Did you know about this?
units.name: BEN
paren: to Poppy, quietly, through his hand

units.text: No, but I knew about the matches. They have matches.
units.name: POPPY
paren: rubbing her head, whispering back

units.text: We have matches!
units.name: THE TWINS
paren: together, holding up a box of matches

units.text: Then I think this is a good night.
units.name: BEN
paren: he takes a candle from one twin and lights it from the other

units.text: ANGLE ON the cake as the candles are lit one at a time.
Poppy and Ben lean in together over the flame.
Make a wish.
units.name: POPPY
paren: softly, only to him

units.text: Already did.
units.name: BEN
paren: smiling, not looking away from her

units.text: BACK TO SCENE.
The twins blow out the candles.
The room goes black.
Again!
units.name: THE TWINS
paren: in the dark
